links.outcome: Readability scores of Spanish patient education materials, AI-generated at 6th grade level versus SPD handouts
links.effect: When prompted for a 6th grade level, both ChatGPT 4.0 and Google Gemini produced significantly improved readability scores compared with SPD handouts (seven readability measures).
links.quote: Our results showed that when prompted to produce material at a 6th grade level, both AI ChatBots generated significantly improved readability scores when compared to the SPD handouts.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM readability performance when applying explicit reading-level constraints in prompts for Spanish patient education materials compared to baseline materials.
